S1_Unclip Img2img：

一个简单的 Unclip 模型高清绘图工作流程

需要配合专用Unclip基本款使用，下载网址：

stableai/stable-diffusion-2-1-unclip 在主处 (拥抱脸网)

comfyanonymous/wd-1.5-beta2_unCLIP 位于 main (拥抱脸网)

S2_IPAdapter高清修复

S1_Unclip pix2pix工作流程的输出不理想，通过IPAdapter重绘，得到更好的结果或者更混乱的结果，但总体更好

S2_IPAdapter+噪音

添加IPAdapterNoise节点，通过选择随机播放类型使画面清晰。缺点是图片细节会减少，与原图的相似度会进一步降低。注意参数强度的调整。适合在第一步混合图片时构图不错但画面很糊的情况下使用，有时还会有意想不到的惊喜。

S2_IP适配器+Lora

添加Lora让改变更彻底，合理选择是否启用IPAdapter Noise，并控制Lora的数量和重量，让画面变得更好，更有你的个人审美

S3_IPAdapter 风格传输

S1_Unclip pix2pix生成的图片构图奇怪，有些还是相当有艺术价值的，但是在后期修复过程中很容易出现色彩混乱和灰色的问题。使用Lora可以在一定程度上改善这个问题，但是不够方便。现在使用 IPAdapter style&Composition SDXL 节点为这些杂乱的图像添加美丽的色彩和新的创造力。

与Lora相比，使用风格迁移会对生成的图像造成更多的变化，并且为了更多地保留原始构图，您可能需要添加其他东西，例如controlnet，或者从添加详细的剪辑正条件开始

S3_IPAdapte + 线条艺术

添加controlnet使构图更加稳定，尤其是人像

S4_Img2img 加

一个增强的图形工作流程，ipadapter不错，但是缺点也很明显，就是细节缺失比较明显，那就回到基础的img2img，添加颜色调整节点来弥补图形颜色问题

S1_Unclip Img2img：

A simple Unclip model HD drawing workflow

Need to use with a dedicated Unclip basic model, download URL：

stabilityai/stable-diffusion-2-1-unclip at main (huggingface.co)

comfyanonymous/wd-1.5-beta2_unCLIP at main (huggingface.co)

S2_IPAdapter HD Fix

The unsatisfactory output of the S1_Unclip pix2pix workflow is redrawn through the IPAdapter to get better results or more chaotic results, but overall better

S2_IPAdapter+Noise

Add IPAdapterNoise nodes to make the picture clear by selecting the shuffle type. The disadvantage is that the picture details will be reduced and the similarity with the original picture will be further reduced. Pay attention to the adjustment of parameter intensity. It is suitable for use in the case that the composition is good but the picture is very mushy in the first step of blending pictures, and sometimes there will be unexpected surprises.

S2_IPAdapter+Lora

Add Lora to make the change more thorough, make a reasonable choice whether to enable IPAdapter Noise, and control the amount and weight of Lora, so that the picture becomes better and has your personal aesthetic

S3_IPAdapter Style transfer

S1_Unclip pix2pix generated pictures with strange composition, some of which are still quite artistic value, but the problem of color confusion and gray is easy to appear in the later repair process. Using Lora can improve this problem to a certain extent, but it is not convenient enough. Now use the IPAdapter style&Composition SDXL node to add beautiful color and new creativity to these cluttered images.

Compared to Lora, the use of style transfer causes more changes to the generated image, and to retain the original composition more, you may need to add something else, such as controlnet，or start by adding a detailed clip positive condition

S3_IPAdapte + line art

Add controlnet to make compositions more stable, especially for portraits

S4_Img2img plus

An enhanced graphics workflow, ipadapter is good, but the shortcomings are obvious, that is, the lack of details is more obvious, then return to the basic img2img, add color adjustment nodes to make up for the graphics color problem
